scope: 🧲 orders the tiles this page is showing — the tab's own top names after its cut — not the whole universe behind it.
rule: 🧲 Bullish GEX first: bullish names (dealers net long gamma, price at or above the flip — dips get bought) strongest first, then mixed, then bearish (net short gamma, price under the flip — moves amplified) weakest first, then names with no read. Strength = net dealer gamma per 1% move ÷ the stock's 50-day average $ volume; it runs larger when the nearest expiry is a day out, so those names rank higher by construction. A read whose nearest expiry has already settled counts as no read. Inside a group, and for mixed / no read, the tab's own order holds. UNMEASURED — no study says this predicts the next move. It re-orders only; it hides, gates, sizes and alerts nothing.
